input: Analyze /var/log/app.log and produce a count per log level (INFO, WARN, ERROR). Print each as 'LEVEL: N' on its own line.

tool_calls: cat /var/log/app.log; echo ----; for l in INFO WARN ERROR; do echo "$l: $(grep -c "\b$l\b" /var/log/app.log)"; done

tool_outputs.stdout:
-rw-r--r--      228 2026-10-09 17:40 /var/log/app.log
INFO: app started
INFO: connected to db
WARN: slow query detected
ERROR: connection timeout
INFO: retry succeeded
